seizures since last night.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EH\/o seizures 3 episodes around 3am, 7am, 11am. Each episode lasting for 3-5 min a\/w uprolling of eyeballs, frothing from mouth.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENot a\/w toungue bite, involuntary micturition, involuntary defecation, lethal cry.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EFollowed by post ictal confusion lasting for 15-20 mins\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EH\/o sob since 10 days, grade II - III.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EH\/o fever 1 week back a\/w chills .\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo H\/o hematuria .\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo h\/o frothy urine.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo h\/o nausea, vomiting, loose stools.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo h\/o decreased urine output, pedal edema.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPt was apparently asymptomatic 10\u0026nbsp; (February 2021)months back then he noticed sudden loss of weight of about 10-15kgs, in a span of 1 \u0026amp; 1\/2 months for which he consulted local doctor where he was diagnosed to have CKD\u0026nbsp; for which he was advised to undergo dialysis I \/v\/o high creatinine levels. He came to our hospital\u0026nbsp; for dialysis , here he tested COVID + , then he came back for dialysis after 2 months .\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EK\/c\/o CKD since April 2021 and is on MHD since June underwent 24 sessions of hemodialysis., Discontinued from 19\/10\/21.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EK\/c\/o HTN +.since 8 months.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENot a k\/c\/o DM, CAD, ASTHMA, TB.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPersonal history:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDiet: mixed .\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAppetite: reduced\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EB\u0026amp;b: regular.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESleep: adequate.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo significant family history.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EOn examination:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPt is c\/c\/c moderately built with mild dehydration.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPallor +, no signs of icterus, cyanosis, clubbing, lymphadenopathy, pedal edema.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETemp: 98.6 f\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPR: 88 bpm\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ERR: 14 cpm\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBP: 160\/100 mm hg\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESpO2:\u0026nbsp; F with AKI ON CKD"},"content":{"type":"html","$t":"\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;A 35 year female, resident of manipaka, came to casualty with\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;c\/o b\/l pedal edema since 20 days,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Edecreased urine output since 20 days,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EFacial puffiness , shortness of breath ( a\/w orthopnea and PND )\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EH\/O fever spike +, 10 days back, not associated with chills and rigor, subsided on taking medication.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EC\/o cough with expectoration,
